issues.claim: "the 'Schedule an appointment' button leads to a 'not found' page, nav buttons have no link"
issues.problem: Half true and overstated. I re-opened the site: the slider 'Schedule an appointment' link does point at https://rakotygroup.com/contacts-us/ which returns HTTP 404 (confirmed), and the single header 'Schedule an appointment' anchor has no href attribute (confirmed - it is the only anchor on the page without one). But the site navigation itself works: the six nav menu items (Home, Non-Profit, Small Businesses, Taxes, Contacts Us, Blog) all carry working hrefs. Read literally, 'nav buttons have no link' is contradicted by the live page and is the kind of error a prospect can spot in ten seconds on their own site.
issues.fix: Reword to: "the header 'Schedule an appointment' button has no link, and the in-page 'Schedule an appointment' button leads to a 'not found' page" - drop the blanket reference to nav buttons.

issues.claim: "your nonprofit page lists close by the 10th ... and each starts with an email chasing a missing statement."
issues.problem: The first half is sourced; the clause about internal workflow is not. /non-profit-2/ lists the deliverables but says nothing about how documents are collected, and no source in profile.json or analysis.json shows an email-based chase. It is the author's inference (correctly framed as an inference in the researcher's profile: 'all of which require collecting documents from many client finance staff') but here it is stated to the firm as fact about their own operations.
issues.fix: Frame it as a question or an inference: e.g. "...and each of those presumably starts with someone at your end chasing a missing statement - worth confirming."

issues.problem: Loose paraphrase of the nonprofit page, which says budget-to-actual is tracked on a monthly basis and grant reports are produced monthly and quarterly; and which describes leading the annual audit process, with no mention of 'audit lists'. Neither phrase is wrong in spirit but neither is what the page says.
issues.fix: Use the page's own wording: "monthly close by the 10th, monthly budget-to-actual plus monthly and quarterly grant reports, the annual audit, 990s and 1099/W-2 season".

issues.claim: Body length of about 450 words (brief requirement)
issues.problem: Borderline but inside tolerance: 424 words of prose excluding title and section headings, 461 words counting them. No change strictly required.
issues.fix: Optional: drop 'Prepared from publicly available information' or one pilot line if the orchestrator wants headroom under 450 including headings.
